- [2026-05-03T20:02:33.859Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #1 — gated affordance visibility. Day 1 EM Bedroom shows 4 in-narrative options: Study, ❌ Too early to sleep ❌, Nap, Wardrobe. The Sleep option is RENDERED with ❌ markers around its label even though it's gated by time-of-day. Player sees the option exists right from Day 1 — discovery is by SEEING NOT FIRING. Doesn't need to click and fail to learn Sleep exists.
- [2026-05-03T20:03:16.139Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #2 — META-DISCOVERY SURFACE = WALKTHROUGH SCENE TABLE. Every NPC + every Location is pre-declared on the Walkthrough page from Day 1. Click an NPC name → drill into a scene table with columns: SCENE / NPC / REQUIREMENTS (NPC) / REQUIREMENTS (MC) / CHANCE / GUIDE / STATUS. The GUIDE column is concrete prose ('Take the test and get at least an 8 grade', 'Have at least 15 relationship points with Marcus, wait for his invite and go to the date with him'). REQUIREMENTS columns are numeric (Corruption: 30) or None. CHANCE is % (100=deterministic, <100=random encounter). STATUS shows 🔒 Locked / 🔓 Unlocked. PLAYER KNOWS ALL CONTENT EXISTS FROM DAY 1 — discovery isn't about IF something exists, it's about HOW to unlock. This is RTS's answer to 'appears from nowhere': activities still pop into the room buttons when prereqs clear, but the player who reads the walkthrough already knew about them.
- [2026-05-03T20:09:28.290Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #3 — POLITE-DECLINE NOTIFY-FAIL. Cheats panel itself is a notify-fail example: clicking it shows 'Cheats are only for Patreons / Become a Patreon / Return'. Player learns WHY (patreon-only) and gets an UPGRADE PATH (Become a Patreon link), not a silent no-op. This is RTS's pattern for hard-gates: tell the player the threshold + offer the way.
- [2026-05-03T20:10:46.903Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #4 — NPC ABSENCE = EXPLAINED EMPTY. Visiting BrotherBedroom when Stepbrother is at school shows: 'Your Stepbrother is at school' + Hallway-return. Empty room is NEVER silently empty. Player learns NPC has a schedule + WHERE he is right now. RTS doesn't make players guess why nothing's happening.
- [2026-05-03T20:11:34.458Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #5 — SAME-BUTTON-ESCALATION IS HIDDEN. Living Room 'Play videogames 🎮' at corruption 0 fires a UTILITY ONE-LINER: 'You are playing a game on the console, you are very focused on the game.' Walkthrough lists 'Playing Videogame' as a Stepbrother scene at Arousal 🔥🔥 + Corruption 10 + 20% chance, GUIDE: 'Play videogame at your living room'. The button label DOES NOT CHANGE between tiers. Player's only signal that escalation exists = walkthrough table. The button is the SAME affordance at every stat tier; what fires varies. Discovery is via meta-surface (walkthrough), not in-button cues.
- [2026-05-03T20:14:42.338Z] DISCOVERY OBSERVATION #6 — TOAST NOTIFY-FAIL CONFIRMED. Clicking School in Residential while wearing Default Casual outfit produces a transient TOAST at top of screen ('You need to wear school clothes to go there!' per prior session catalog) without changing the passage. Player learns the gate-reason without a hard interruption (no modal, no passage change). Toast is short-lived. Same pattern from sidebar 'Go to School' shortcut. Combined with Cheats panel (polite-decline) + room-button ❌ labeling (visible disabled), RTS uses THREE notify-fail tiers: (1) ❌ visible-disabled label = soft-known-blocked, (2) transient TOAST = clicked-and-learned, (3) modal page (Cheats) = fundamental gate with upgrade path.

- [2026-05-03T20:45:10.081Z] DEEP PROGRESSION FINDINGS (Day 2, played to PeepBrotherSex completion):

OBSERVATION #9 — STATUS COLUMN = COMPLETION TRACKER (NOT ACCESSIBILITY GATE).
Walkthrough STATUS flipped from 🔒 Locked to ✅ Unlocked only after the player completed PeepBrotherSex through to its climax (final 'Cum!' choice). Backed by per-scene state: 'npc.Brother.scenes.PeepBrotherSex.unlocked: false → true' written at the climax. So the walkthrough is a SCENE CHECKLIST / GALLERY — REQUIREMENTS columns + GUIDE prose tell HOW to satisfy each scene; STATUS shows WHICH you've COMPLETED. This is much closer to an achievement-tracker design than a real-time-gate display.

OBSERVATION #10 — FALL-THROUGH SCENES vs CANONICAL.
Earlier I clicked 'Sleep with him 💤' at MC corruption 30 + Brother arousal 🔥🔥🔥 + Brother corruption 0 (one walkthrough requirement NOT met). Got a soft cuddle vignette then 'Go to your bedroom and sleep' — that was a FALL-THROUGH alt scene, not the canonical 'Sleep with Stepbrother'. STATUS stayed 🔒. PeepBrotherSex with all reqs met fired its full drip → STATUS ✅. Walkthrough requirements are SOFT for ATTEMPTS but HARD for COMPLETION-CREDIT.

OBSERVATION #11 — IN-CONTEXT BUTTON INJECTION (Q1 RESOLVED).
Visiting BrotherBedroom at MC corruption 31 + Brother arousal 🔥🔥 + Brother corruption 15 + relation 10 + evening = FOUR new buttons appeared in the room: Talk / Tease / Flash / Have sex. Same passage as Day 1 (which showed only 'is not in his bedroom' + Hallway). No notification, no toast, no quest update — buttons just showed up. Player walks in with the right state and the room is denser. THIS is RTS's primary 'new activity appears' pattern: location passages render their button set conditionally on (MC stats, NPC stats, time, day, relation) and the differential is the discovery moment. Walking into a familiar room and noticing 3 new buttons IS the unlock notification.

OBSERVATION #12 — RANDOM ENCOUNTER ENTRY GATING.
PeepBrotherSex fired on room entry as a 25%-chance random encounter (per walkthrough table). Did NOT appear as a button in the prior turn — it INTERCEPTED the room visit and replaced the normal room render with its own scene. So 'random encounter' fires are PASSAGE OVERRIDES at navigation time, not a button-list addition. Player attempts to enter a room → dice roll → either normal room OR an encounter scene takes over.

OBSERVATION #13 — LINKREPLACE-DRIP CONFIRMED.
PeepBrotherSex used 4-step linkreplace: Peep → adds paragraph + new choice 'Stroke your pussy' → adds paragraph + 'Masturbate' → adds paragraph + 'Cum!' → final paragraph + Hallway exit. Same passage throughout. Player perceives a sustained scene with multiple beats; engine sees one passage with progressive content reveal. Climax choice writes the unlocked flag + corruption +1 + arousal -1.

OBSERVATION #14 — SCHEDULED FUTURE OPENINGS WITH COUNTDOWN PHRASING.
Sleeping a night flipped many location.X.open false→true AND others changed location.X.opensAt from 'Tomorrow (Afternoon)' → 'Afternoon'. RTS shows scheduled openings with day-relative countdown phrasing in the variable model — possibly surfaced somewhere in UI.
